title: London Travel Vlog｜falling in love with London｜places to visit and eat｜bakery & cafe hopping｜
description:
Hi, welcome to my channel :)

I took my first trip to London! I've been so excited to visit for so long, that it felt unreal to make it here. Of course, I had to go to the sightseeing tourist places. I was lucky enough to visit around Christmas, too. The illumination over the roads was beautiful and I'll never forget it. I tried many types of bakeries, cafes, and restaurants. There's so many other places I want to try next time I go, so if you have recommendations let me know! London, I miss you already!
